title: mycobactopia-org/xbs-variant-calling pipeline - params.input schema
description: Samplesheet schema. Compatible with MAGMA's per-library shape (study, sample, library, r1, r2) so MAGMA can feed XBS_VARIANT_CALLING the same samplesheet it uses internally.

study.errorMessage: Study name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

library.errorMessage: Library name must be provided and cannot contain spaces; one row per library when a sample has multiple

attempt.errorMessage: Attempt (optional): sequencing-attempt counter. Currently informational; safe to omit or set to 1.

flowcell.errorMessage: Flowcell (optional): flowcell identifier. Used as the first component of the BWA read-group ID (ID:<flowcell>.<lane>.<index>). Defaults to 'UNNAMED' when omitted.

lane.errorMessage: Lane (optional): sequencing lane number. Used as the second component of the BWA read-group ID. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

index_sequence.errorMessage: Index_sequence (optional): barcode index. Used as the third component of the BWA read-group ID. Defaults to 'NNNNNNNN' when omitted.

r1.errorMessage: Read 1 FASTQ must exist, cannot contain spaces, and must end in .fq.gz or .fastq.gz

r2.errorMessage: Read 2 FASTQ must exist, cannot contain spaces, and must end in .fq.gz or .fastq.gz
